subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Wirecard Scandal
description: A fast breakdown of The Wirecard Scandal for builders.

hook.text: Wirecard was a German fintech giant worth $24 billion. Then $2.1 billion went missing.

buildup.text: The company claimed billions in revenue from Asian partners. Auditors accepted the numbers.

discovery.text: Journalists at the Financial Times raised alarms for years. German regulators attacked the journalists instead.

twist.text: When investigators finally checked, the Asian bank accounts simply didn't exist.

climax.text: CEO Markus Braun was arrested. COO Jan Marsalek vanished and is believed to be in Russia.

punchline.text: The regulators investigated the journalists, not the fraud.

quiz.question: What did German regulators do when journalists flagged Wirecard's fraud?
